column1: # RECOIL supports none of these formats. No independent decoder (Deark and ffmpeg have none) renders them, so the evidence is the cited document plus review by eye, stated per row.

column4: VMU game file (header at 0x200, two 32x32 icon frames side by side); RECOIL does not support it. Layout per Comstedt and KallistiOS vmu_pkg; render reviewed by eye: two frames of falling Tetris pieces in green and blue on the transparent grey, matching the header text "Tiny Tetris"
